messages:
incident-bot: ALERT — elevated 5xx rate (~6%) for /v1/chat.generate across us-west-2 and us-east-1. Preliminary signal: model-pin -> fallback to incompatible 'embed' variant. Paging on-call: @eric-oncall

eric-oncall: I'm awake, looking. Can someone paste the pin config and the most recent rollout? :eyes:

ashok: Tracing now. Quick grep of routing logs shows a /route decision that pins "redwood-chat-v1" to "redwood-embed-v1-quant" when capacity low. Likely mismatch (chat vs embed). Logs:
```
route=smart_fallback selected=redwood-embed-v1-quant fallback_reason=pin_mismatch original_request=chat.generate
```

mike-sre: Confirmed. 500s are from the runtime calling gen path on an embed-only kernel -> schema/kernel mismatch errors. Repro: call with chat.messages -> 500 and stacktrace shows kernel.select failed for "gen" ops.

eric-oncall: Mitigation options: 1) Unpin the problematic version (fast) 2) Patch routing policy to fallback to compatible chat variant 3) Temporarily disable smart-fallback to variants with non-matching modality. Which do we want now?

lisa-pm: Customer-impact: multiple mid-market customers reporting degraded chat responses. CS looped in @amy-cs. Need careful communication if we unpin broadly.

amy-cs: Heads-up: two accounts opened support tickets referencing 500s on chat endpoints. Want ETA for fix and whether we should advise workarounds.

deploy-bot: Rollout detected: model-pin update 1971234500 -> redwood-chat-v1 pinned to zone us-west-2 at 00:10 UTC by ci/cd pipeline "deploy/pin-model"

eric-oncall: I'm going to unpin the version in the control plane now (risky but quick). Command I will run:
```
redwoodctl pins delete --name redwood-chat-v1 --env prod
```

ashok: Also recommending a quick routing-policy patch to prevent modality-mismatched fallbacks. I pushed a staging PR that rejects embed variants for requests where request.modality==\"chat\". If unpin doesn't fully resolve, we'll promote that.

eric-oncall: Unpin complete. Observability: 5xx rate dropping to ~0.6% in us-west-2 within 90s, latency starting to normalize. Still watching for residual errors and any canary hosts that still have pinned config.

mike-sre: I'll tail the runtime logs and surface any hosts still trying to route to embed variants. Also adding a temporary alert: 'pin->fallback:different-modality' to catch regressions.

lisa-pm: Amy, please prepare a short note to the affected customers: explain we routed to an incompatible variant, we've reverted the pin, and are monitoring. No data loss. Keep it simple.

amy-cs: Draft ready, sending to the two ticketing customers now. Copying internal postmortem note to the CS thread.

eric-oncall: For handoff: @tzuchi you'll take watch for the next 4 hours. If 5xx creeps above 1% again, either reapply a safe stable pin (redwood-chat-v1-stable) with canary rollout, or set policy to strict-modality until root fix.

tzuchi: Taking handoff. Confirm thresholds and runbook?

mike-sre: Runbook: if 5xx > 1% for 2 consecutive minutes -> 1) scale down problematic pool, 2) enforce strict-modality routing policy, 3) if still failing, roll back to last stable pin via `redwoodctl pins set --name redwood-chat-v1-stable --canary 10` then 50.

lisa-pm: Postmortem owner request: @mike-sre please take root-cause and action items (routing validation, pre-deploy checks, pin-tool compatibility checks).

mike-sre: Ack. Initial action items: add modality-compatibility validation to pin tool; add unit/integration tests for smart-routing fallback combos; add pre-deploy check in CI that flags pins where target variants differ in modality; create an alert for pin->fallback modality mismatch.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED — severity downgraded to P2. Timeline and logs archived at https://internal.redwood/incident/1971234567. Action items assigned.

amy-cs: Customer notes sent to two affected customers; they acknowledged and will re-open if they see more errors. :white_check_mark:

tzuchi: Monitoring OK at handoff. No further 5xx spikes in last 10m. Taking on-call.

eric-oncall: Closing active pager. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
